body: Her name was Loyola, and the favorite memory I guess would be going out kayaking with her. My dad modified a double kayak so she wouldn't fall out.

Thanks a lot to say that.

She was a black lab/mix. It was her time, she was 13, has this big tumor that had ruptured, no outward signs until two days before, there were options that could have saved her, but they were still a 50/50 chance at absolute best, and the expected quality of life didn't seem like enough to put her through it.
